summary.zh: （範例）大盤先漲後跌，科技股波動加大，防禦類股相對穩定
summary.en: (Sample) The market rose then slipped; tech got more volatile while defensive stocks held up

text.zh: （範例）VOO 週初連漲兩天，週四回落，整週小幅收低
text.en: (Sample) VOO rose for two days early in the week, pulled back on Thursday and ended slightly lower

text.zh: （範例）半導體股的危險訊號從週一 3 檔增加到週五 8 檔
text.en: (Sample) Warning signals among chip stocks grew from 3 on Monday to 8 on Friday

text.zh: （範例）醫療與必需消費類股多次出現在偏多訊號
text.en: (Sample) Healthcare and consumer staples appeared in bullish signals several times

text.zh: （範例）利率與通膨數據是本週最常出現的新聞主題
text.en: (Sample) Rates and inflation data were the most common news themes

text.zh: （範例）留意危險訊號是否持續增加，以及財報公布後的波動
text.en: (Sample) Watch whether warning signals keep rising, and volatility after earnings
